## Findings

1. Process (for Scott). Q2 resolved new behavior the spec does not state: several folders with the same SPECIAL-USE flag is an error. The build rule says a behavior-changing resolution bumps the spec version. Proposed: spec v1.2 adds REQ-19-1 for Q2, with a matrix row owned by C2 pointing at the existing resolver test. Q1 is staging test config only and needs no REQ. This touches the trace self-test that expects exactly 276 REQs, so it lands as one small commit together with that count change.
2. Note for C4 and C5. Message IDs are unsigned base64 JSON, so a caller can hand in any account and folder. Tools must check the decoded account against the registry, and write paths must enforce their own folder rules. Routed to C4 and C5 with a required test.
3. Partial rows REQ-2-7 (completes in C5) and REQ-2-19 (completes in C4 to C6) are honest and now carry explicit completion steps in those prompts.

## Builder choices reviewed

Consistent with the spec or harmless: registry stays in `wrangler.toml`; uppercase OR/NOT and leading `-`, `(`, `{`, `|` rejected while lowercase `or`/`not` are bare words; empty filter is `ALL`; `CHARSET UTF-8` for non-ASCII (required by IMAP, verified on both hosts); IDs carry the real folder path; missing Archive during fallback is an error rather than a silent skip; overrides are trusted and fail at SELECT if wrong.

## Needs Scott

- Approve the spec v1.2 bump for Q2 (finding 1).
